params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of insights to return. Defaults to 100.

params.name: marketId
params.description: Geo Market identifier (e.g., 'planet$earth'). If omitted, defaults to global market.

params.name: ip
params.description: IP Address Family ('v4' or 'v6'). Defaults to 'v4'.

params.name: lookback
params.description: Lookback in days. Allowed values: 1, 7, 30. Defaults to 1.

params.name: types
params.description: Insight types to include. Provide as repeated query params, e.g., types=market_entrance&types=market_exit. Allowed: market_entrance, market_exit, ranking_gain, ranking_loss, start_prefix_origination, stop_prefix_origination, increase_prefix_origination, decrease_prefix_origination, customer_gain, customer_loss, customer_routing_gain, customer_routing_loss, provider_gain, provider_loss, provider_routing_gain, provider_routing_loss.

params.name: magnitude
params.description: Minimum magnitude (severity) threshold, integer 1–5. Defaults to 1.
